jcr:content.jcr:description: AEM products for digital experience, content management, Content Fragments, and Experience Manager Cloud Service.
jcr:content.jcr:title: AEM Products

overview.text: Adobe Experience Manager Sites supports enterprise content management and consistent digital experience delivery. AEM products give teams a central platform to create, govern, publish, and search web content across channels.

capabilities.text: Content Fragments enable reusable structured content for headless applications, while Experience Manager Cloud Service provides a Cloud-based foundation for scalable authoring and delivery. These AEM capabilities make product content easier to organize, index, and retrieve through a search integration such as Apache Solr.
